ownership: Project-owned factual summary, GPL-3.0-or-later; no copied upstream implementation or documentation excerpt.
established_facts: Stream Deck 7.0 introduced a key container with separate single-press, double-press and hold actions.
SupportedInKeyLogicActions is an optional action eligibility boolean with an upstream default of true; it is independent of SupportedInMultiActions.
The pinned schema only permits the explicit key-logic eligibility field in Software.MinimumVersion branches starting at 7.0.
The current SDK documents keypad single-action and multi-action payloads, but the reviewed sources do not identify a separate key-logic payload contract.
not_established: Exact vendor timing thresholds, deadlines and ambiguous press/release ordering.
Whether every Key Logic child uses multi-action payloads, coordinates, desired state and automatic-state timing identical to a Multi Action.
Synthetic release timing, branch context identity and lifecycle behavior against a reference host.
manager_boundary: The existing Gesture payload is exposed as Key logic (Manager), using configurable timings and existing nested action contexts and pulse dispatch. Elgato plugin descendants require both eligibility flags; two-state descendants retain explicit desired-state selection. This is a Manager feature, not verified Stream Deck Key Logic parity. Explicit 7.0 packages remain subject to the unchanged production host-minimum gate.
